about: packages/flock/src/props.json: the flock story's part of the catalogue of 3D sets (props; docs/props.md, tools/packages/SPEC.md "Miniatures"): what the design room's card of each of its miniatures shows; code is authoritative

sets.shows: Starlings at dusk all around you: 200 birds (50 to 400, a live simulation), each following its seven nearest neighbours, keeping its distance and fleeing a falcon with alarm passing between neighbours; sky, a lake, trees and reeds; the flock swoops round you every 88 s.
sets.frame: Life size: 1 unit = 1 m, the viewer at the origin, ground y = 0, the sun sets towards -z.
sets.size: life size; sky to the horizon, 2,600 reeds within 32 m

params.name: flock_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: flock_birds
params.meaning: how many birds (50-400; new ones join beside a bird already flying)

params.name: flock_sky
params.meaning: the sky, land and reeds; below 0.5 (passthrough AR) hidden, the flock at a third of life size in your room

params.name: flock_falcon
params.meaning: above 0.5 a falcon comes now and then

params.name: flock_hunt
params.meaning: a falcon each time this passes a whole number (for the story)

views.name: default
views.frames: standing in the field, looking up at the sky

views.name: afar
views.frames: the engine aims it at the flock

data.text: A live simulation; nothing is data.

sets.notes: update depends on history, so seeking changes only the params. In a shared room the flock belongs to the station. In passthrough the sky and land are hidden and the flock flies in your room at a third of life size. Step params flock_birds, flock_hunt. Exports see(head, hands, spot), scatter(dir), falcon, follow, hush, state.
